title: glab api projects/${project}/milestones/${id}/issues?per_page=100 --paginate
description: The issues of one milestone, ${id} its own, not its iid: every one, which prints one such array per page, whose states kit counts into the milestone's open and closed (forge/gitlab:milestones in `modules/bash/forge/gitlab.sh`, with forge::gitlab_milestones in `modules/jq/forge.jq`), as GitLab's milestone list holds no count. The types are APIEntitiesIssueBasic of GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/milestones/{milestone_id}/issues in GitLab's REST OpenAPI, https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/raw/master/doc/api/openapi/openapi_v3.yaml, as https://docs.gitlab.com/api/milestones/#get-all-issues-assigned-to-a-single-milestone describes them.
